subject.title: refactor(ui): sidebar IA cleanup: Activity to Settings, Dreams into Agents Memory tab, single MCP mutation owner

question: Should existing `/dreaming` and `/dreams` bookmarks intentionally stop resolving when Memory moves under Agents?
rationale: The patch deletes a user-visible route without a redirect, and the linked protected-label issue records that compatibility choice as maintainer-owned product direction.

options.title: Remove without redirect
options.body: Make the Agents Memory tab the sole canonical destination and accept that old Dreams bookmarks no longer resolve.

options.title: Add temporary redirect
options.body: Redirect the old Dreams URLs to Agents Memory for a bounded deprecation window.

recommendation.title: Remove without redirect
recommendation.body: Make the Agents Memory tab the sole canonical destination and accept that old Dreams bookmarks no longer resolve.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history most directly owns the affected navigation and memory direction.
